Visible-element check before revising: all text blocks and the three thin rules are already present and readable; no missing copy, frames, boxes, or decorative shapes needed for this pass. The reviewer only flagged the main title cluster composition. Repair focuses only on BRUNCH and Vibes. BRUNCH was visually too far right and a bit too narrow in ink; Vibes sat slightly too far left/lower and ended early on the right. I adjusted headline placement using ink-vs-CSS offset logic, widened it via tracking only, and kept the tall Didot treatment. I nudged the brush word up/right and added forward slant with skew while preserving the existing brush height scaling. LocalDidot still depends on a local Didot installation, so serif silhouette portability remains environment-dependent; GeorgiaBrush remains the supplied brush asset.
AI visual checklist passed; manual approval still required.
Didot uses the installed Mac font; export requires that font on the viewing machine.
